title: Maximum influence coordinate
statement: For a positive integer $n$ and a Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $i_f\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be the coordinate selected to have maximum influence among the coordinates of $f$.
caveat: The statement relies on an omitted existence result for the maximum-influence property, so the precise definition of influence is unavailable.
